milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The birch leaves canopy center is at spawn-relative (6, 4, 6). The agent must navigate near the birch tree and face toward the leaves to demonstrate they have found them. max_distance=16 allows finding from anywhere in the enclosure, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at the tree.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 dark_oak_buttons and 2 dark_oak_planks, so having ≥1 dark_oak_button confirms successful crafting (recipe: 1 dark_oak_plank → 1 dark_oak_button in crafting table).

Uses inventory_has because mining the acacia_wall_sign causes it to drop as an acacia_sign item which the player picks up. This is preferred over count_in_box_at_most(kind=block) because it directly confirms the player obtained the mined item. Wall signs drop as regular sign items in Minecraft (acacia_wall_sign → acacia_sign).
